newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Zinc association seeks 500,000 tonne/yr rise in usage.
newsitem.headline: Zinc association seeks 500,000 tonne/yr rise in usage.

text.p: The International Zinc Association (IZA) said on Monday it wanted to revitalise the zinc market by boosting consumption by 500,000 tonnes per year within five years on top of the market's natural growth.
"Together with our partners we intend to make a significant difference on zinc consumption," IZA Executive Director Edouard Gervais told a zinc conference.
He said that consumption growth opportunities were numerous and significant as most markets were far from saturated.
General galvanising was one development area as it was price and performance competitive with paint systems.

Gervais said promotion of continuous galvanised sheet steel was required. He noted the market share of zinc coated cold rolled steel sheet, currently at about 40 percent, was expected to rise to 50 percent by 2000.
The growth potential in emerging markets was evident if consumption per head or intensity of use in various regions was compared, he said.

IZA, whose priorities also included automotive applications and zinc alloy die-casting, and its partners are implementing 13 programmes to help market development and more are being considered, Gervais said.

In the immediate future, IZA plans to focus on strengthening its network of regional associations, boosting existing partnerships and fostering new ones, he added. --Bert Lauwers, Brussels Newsroom +32 2 287 6815, Fax +32 2 230 7710
